note: Both sets capture the page's key annotated values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0 = -25.52E+6 watt/rad, θK = 6.302336°, and the doubling relation of Eq. 7-17) and both repeat them redundantly, and both share the same bad graph estimate of -90E+6 at the last data point (the point near 23° is about -115E+6). Set B adds two clear misreadings of the text: it labels ∂P/∂θ(θ=0) as the "slope" and θK as the "intercept" of the best-fit line, whereas the page says the slope and intercept are the two bracketed terms of Eq. (7-16a) and θK is a blade-pitch angle where sensitivity has doubled. Set A avoids those mislabels and keeps the θK and rated-point values correctly bound, though it loosely attributes several turbine quantities to the "Blade-Pitch Controller" and uses the legend entry "Original Data" as a quote that does not support its plotted-value claims. Overall A is somewhat more faithful, with fewer substantive misreads.
